headline: Elevated Diesel Fuel Prices Threaten Solvency of Small US Trucking Firms
summary: High diesel prices are severely straining small US trucking firms operating with low margins, pushing some businesses toward bankruptcy.
why: Diesel fuel is one of the largest operating expenses for freight transport firms, directly affecting corporate margins across the transportation and logistics sectors.

impacts.name: US Diesel Fuel
impacts.why: Elevated fuel prices raise operational costs for transport companies.
